---
# payments-eventbus-lab: payments message pipeline on OpenShift (AWS)
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Payments Eventbus Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

aws_region: eu-west-3
worker_instance_count: 3
worker_instance_type: m6i.2xlarge
ocp4_installer_version: "4.18"

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_cert_manager
  - ocp4_workload_kafka_topics
  - ocp4_workload_payments_app
  - ocp4_workload_streams_operator

ocp4_workload_streams_operator_channel: stable
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_namespace: payments
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_cluster: payments-kafka
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_partitions: 6
ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_names:
  - payments.authorized
  - payments.settled
  - payments.disputed
ocp4_workload_payments_app_replicas: 2

# payments-eventbus-lab: payments message pipeline on OpenShift (AWS)
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Payments Eventbus Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

aws_region: eu-west-3
worker_instance_count: 3
worker_instance_type: m6i.2xlarge

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_cert_manager
  - ocp4_workload_kafka_topics
  - ocp4_workload_payments_app
  - ocp4_workload_streams_operator

  - payments.disputed

---
__meta__:
  catalog:
    disable: false
  lifespan:
    default: 1d
    maximum: 2d

---
__meta__:
  catalog:
    disable: false
  lifespan:
    default: 1d
    maximum: 2d

---
# Create the lab's Kafka topics as KafkaTopic custom resources.
# The KafkaTopic CRD is installed by the Strimzi operator
# (ocp4_workload_streams_operator), which must run before this workload.

- name: Create the payments topics
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: kafka.strimzi.io/v1beta2
      kind: KafkaTopic
      metadata:
        name: "{{ item }}"
        namespace: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_namespace }}"
        labels:
          strimzi.io/cluster: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_cluster }}"
      spec:
        partitions: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_partitions }}"
        replicas: 3
  loop: "{{ ocp4_workload_kafka_topics_names }}"
